messages:
vivian.choi: Hi folks  first-day question  I can get into Console staging but /admin/feature-flags returns a 403. need to flip a flag for a smoke canary. who should I loop in? :wave:
ryan_infra: welcome! that path is RBAC-protected. do you see the main app and just that admin subpath 403? try incognito to clear SSO cookies.
vivian.choi: incognito same result. main console works, admin path 403.
leah_infra: looks like group mapping. quick API check: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/me` share the `groups` array (redact token).
vivian.choi: groups: [\"eng-ml\"]. no admin groups.
leah_infra: OK. we do temporary staging elevations for onboarding tasks. sam.platform approves.
sam.platform: I can approve a 6-hour JIT role. please create an ONB ticket with manager + reason and ping me.
vivian.choi: ONB-5101 created, added manager @ryan_infra and note about quick canary validation.
sam.platform: approved. @onboarding-bot grant role.
onboarding-bot: role `staging-ff-admin` granted to vivian.choi until 2026-03-23T18:30:00Z. audit=AUD-20260323-9001.
vivian.choi: confirmed access, can see the flags. thanks! one more q: where's the lite checklist for step ramps so I don't break SLOs?
leah_infra: short guide: start at 1% for 15m, check errors/p95, then 10% increments. set automatic rollback on +50% error or p95 +200ms. docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/feature-flags/canary-runbook
ryan_infra: also run the preview rule before enabling and keep the onboarding ticket for audits.
vivian.choi: perfect, thanks everyone :)
